title: The party
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, frozen small town at night in winter, stopped clocks and faded New Year's Eve decorations, icy blue and tarnished gold tones, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. Same New Year's party, every year. He's in last year's photo. 🎉

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Theo Park drove into Merrow Falls, where every clock, and his own watch, froze at 11:59.
scenes.image: a car parked on a snowy main street strung with party lights, a frozen clock tower above

scenes.narration: He took a room above the diner. The sheets smelled like cedar. The TV only played one channel: a countdown show, frozen on a smiling host.
scenes.image: an old boxy television in a dim rented room showing a blurry frozen image of a smiling host and confetti

scenes.narration: In the morning, if it was morning, the town was decorating again. The same streamers. Taken down. Hung back up in the same places.
scenes.image: a man on a ladder hanging silver streamers on a snowy town square at night

scenes.narration: Theo asked the man on the ladder why. He said, cheerful: party's tonight. Biggest one of the century.
scenes.image: a cheerful man in a 1990s sweater on a ladder, waving down, string lights around him

scenes.narration: On the diner counter, the morning paper. December thirty-first, 1999. Crisp. Not a hint of yellow.
scenes.image: a crisp folded newspaper beside a steaming coffee cup on a diner counter, headline blurred

scenes.narration: In the town hall, he found the party photos. One for every year since. Same banner. Same band. Same faces. Not one of them a day older.
scenes.image: a stack of party photographs on a wooden table showing the same smiling crowd in 1990s clothes

scenes.narration: Twenty-seven years of the same party. And not one of them has ever heard the countdown finish.
scenes.image: confetti frozen in mid-air over a crowd in a snowy square, everyone perfectly still

scenes.narration: Then one photo stopped him. Last year's. In the back of the crowd, half turned toward the camera, stood a man in a grey coat holding a notebook.
scenes.image: a man's hand holding an old party photograph up to a desk lamp

scenes.narration: It was Theo. Wearing the coat he had on right now.
scenes.image: close-up of a man in a grey coat staring at his own hands in disbelief, lamplight

scenes.narration: Outside, the band started tuning up for tonight. And somebody in the square began to count. Slowly. Sixty.
scenes.image: a small band on a snowy outdoor stage under string lights, the crowd turning toward the clock tower
